description.zh: 接收消息的互动消息应用ID。
description.en: The ID of the interactive messaging application that is used to receive the message.
The message body. It can be up to 15 KB in length.

description.zh: 数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
description.en:
The data center, which must be the same as the data center specified in [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~). Valid values:

- cn-shanghai: Shanghai
- ap-southeast-1: Singapore

description.zh:
接收消息的GroupId。
> 请确保传入的GroupId是存在的！否则会返回ResourceNotExist错误。
description.en:
The ID of the group that receives the message.

> Make sure that the specified GroupId is available. Otherwise, a ResourceNotExist error is returned.

description.zh: 消息唯一标识，可作为删除消息的依据。由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节。
description.en: The unique identifier of the message. This parameter is used to delete the message. The ID can contain only letters and digits and can be up to 64 bytes in length.

description.zh: 消息类型，单群内发送消息的总类型数不超过30种。
description.en: The message type. The total number of message types sent within a single group cannot exceed 30.

description.zh: 设置不缓存该消息到最近消息列表中。默认为false，表示缓存到群组最近消息列表中。
description.en: Specifies whether to disable message caching to the list of the latest messages in the group. Valid values: true and false. Default value: false, which indicates that the message is cached.

description.zh: 设置不存储该消息。默认为 false，表示存储（当前时效30天），可以通过获取查询群组消息查到该消息。如果您的业务不需要存储该消息，请设置为true。
description.en: Specifies whether to disable message storage. Valid values: true and false. Default value: false, which indicates that the message is stored for a validity period of 30 days. You can find the message in the response of the ListLiveMessageGroupMessages operation. If you do not need to store the message, set this parameter to true.

description.zh: 发送消息的用户ID，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节。
description.en: The ID of the user who sends the message. The ID can be up to 64 bytes in length and can contain letters and digits.

description.zh: 发送消息用户的扩展信息，长度不超过512字节。
description.en: The additional information about the user who sends the message. The value can be up to 512 bytes in length.

description.zh: 该消息对于该类消息数量的统计增长值贡献，默认值为1。
description.en: The contribution of the message to the increase in the number of messages of this type. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
消息权重，默认值为 1。
- 对于点赞等低优消息，可设置权重为 1；
- 对于弹幕等普通文本消息，可设置权重为 5；
- 对于红包、礼物等高优消息，可设置权重为 1000000。
description.en:
The weight of the message. Default value: 1.

- For low-priority messages such as likes, you can set the weight to 1.
- For regular text messages such as bullet comments, you can set the weight to 5.
- For high-priority messages such as red envelopes and gifts, you can set the weight to 1000000.

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~)创建互动消息群组。发送消息到群组，目标群组需要是激活状态，即当前群组中有用户已加入，才能正常往群组发送消息。不支持离线消息，如果遇到发送消息失败，请先确认当前群组中是否有用户。若需离线发送，建议将先消息存在本地，待用户上线后重新发送。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, you must call [](t2586945.xdita#)to create an interactive messaging group. You can send messages to a group only if the group is active, which means that one or more users have joined the group. Offline messages are not supported. If you fail to send a message, check whether there are users in the group. If you want to send an offline message, we recommend that you store the message locally and send it after users come online.

## QPS limits

You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions. We recommend that you consider this limit when calling this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live send-live-message-group --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --sender-id uid1 --sender-meta-info uid1meta1 --biz-body hello,group --msg-type 1 --msg-tid 1698300000 --statics-increase 1 --weight 1 --no-storage false --no-cache false --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live SendLiveMessageGroup --region cn-hangzhou --DataCenter 'cn-shanghai' --AppId demo --StaticsIncrease 1 --MsgTid 1698300000 --SenderMetaInfo uid1meta1 --MsgType 1 --SenderId uid1 --NoCache false --Body 'hello,group' --Weight 1 --GroupId grouptest --NoStorage false
